No platform path covers it: the Linux CI install hoists, so CI is green. It reaches every developer whose pnpm does not hoist; today that is the maintainer on macOS (#36777 is stuck behind it).

The seat's hoisted install of the same tree passes. So the hoist hypothesis on the card is confirmed on Linux, and the hoist-disabled install is the regression base.
Serial constraints cleared: `overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD` on a local probe commit touching `packNamespace.ts`, `ui/packages/i18n/package.json`, `.npmrc` and `pnpm-workspace.yaml`: `VERDICT clean exit 0`; the one open PR head sharing a file is #35129 (`chore: version packages`, shares `ui/packages/i18n/package.json`), which merges cleanly. No in-flight claim on this surface.

Pre-claim deps: no `Blocked-by:` line; #36777 (open, os-warren) waits on this card, not the reverse; #36753 closed
Prior rulings read: `check-prior-rulings.mjs --card 37015 --paths …` read at `origin/main`: ① 12 hit lines in 2 files, each read: the `pnpm-workspace.yaml` rulings (#3653, #5835, #6095, #13715, #16186, maintainer 2026-08-25) govern OSV override pins and version selectors, not hoisting; the `packNamespace.ts` ⛔ lines govern the single loader and its never-overwrite merge, which this fix does not touch. ② same-day churn 7a5ae65e (docs(spec)), not this surface: 基于合并后的代码工作,issue 引用的片段可能已变,先核对当前 main。 ③ #36777 open (os-warren), #36753 closed. The ADR names the reader lists are term-noise hits on `build`/`read`, none on pnpm hoisting or this package. No conflicting record.
